b1-p1: Kasaman E. Solutions – Your Reliable Partner in the Field of Electrical Accessories.
b1-p2: Kasaman E. Solutions was founded in 2023 with the aim of providing the Armenian market with high-quality, safe and modern electrical accessories. We import and sell a wide range of plugs, extension cords, electrical switches and other necessary accessories.
b2-p: We work only with verified suppliers and guarantee the quality of the products.
b3-p: Communication with each customer is built on trust and transparency.
b4-p: Our team ensures that you receive the right product at the right time.
b6-p: Our mission Kasaman E. Solutions is not just a seller. We are your trusted partner, standing by your side, helping you choose the best solutions for your home, office or production space. Our goal is to make purchasing electrical accessories easy, convenient and reliable.
